# PrivateVoting | Comprehensive Platform Overview

> PrivateVoting is a secure, auditable, and multi-tenant Private Online Voting platform providing School Voting, College Voting, Housing Society Voting, and Organization Elections with real-time auditability and anonymous digital ballots.

## Overview

PrivateVoting facilitates modern digital elections for educational institutions, residential societies, non-profit organizations, and corporations. The platform ensures end-to-end election integrity, privacy of individual ballots, and instant tallying.

## Core Features & Workflow

- **Election Setup & Multi-Ballot Events**: Configure complex election posts in a single event.
- **Candidate Management**: Upload spreadsheets with candidate rosters, attach candidate portraits, and customize candidate ordering.
- **Voter Verification & Access Control**: Support for email verification, student ID/roll numbers, apartment numbers, and unique verification tokens.
- **Dual Storage Architecture**: Resilient cloud asset storage powered by Cloudinary and AWS S3 with automatic failover and optimized image compression (50KB-100KB).
- **Sub-User & Polling Officer Delegation**: Granular permission scoping allowing staff, teachers, or committee members to manage polling booths without accessing administrative controls.
- **Live Auditing & Reports**: Instant count tabulation upon poll closure, downloadable certified PDF result certificates, and Excel voter turnout logs.
- **Security & Restriction**: Optional IP-range restriction, strict voting time windows with buffer-time safeguards, and tamper-evident ballots.
